title: A Comprehensive Reassessment of the Global Illegal Wildlife Trade's Economic Value全球非法野生动植物贸易经济价值的全面重新评估**
content:
Through systematic price collection and correction for underreporting and undetected seizures, the global illegal wildlife trade (IWT) is estimated at US$28.4–39.5 billion per year. This finding highlights that previous valuations were underestimates.


ABSTRACT

The illegal wildlife trade (IWT) remains a major driver of global biodiversity loss and is considered to be one of the most profitable forms of transnational organised crime. A widely cited valuation estimated IWT's annual worth at US$7–23 billion; however, its methodology is unclear and outdated, with the world changing significantly since then. Hence, we developed a methodologically transparent and updated estimate of the global IWT value. Based on IWT seizures reported in TRAFFIC's open-access Wildlife Trade Portal, prices for each species–product combination were obtained through a systematic search, and then corrected using expansion factors to account for underreporting and under-detection. Using seizures reported between 2016 and 2021, we conservatively estimated the mean annual economic value of IWT to be US$34.0 ± 3.42 billion (5th–95th percentile uncertainty range: US$28.4–39.5 billion), after correcting for global reported volumes and undetected seizures. Furthermore, analysis of the TRAFFIC seizure records showed that non-CITES-listed taxa accounted for roughly 5% of the total economic value of reported seizures, highlighting the presence of unregulated species in international trade and regulatory gaps. Our transparent and reproducible framework offers a necessary update to long-standing underestimates, which can then be aligned with international enforcement and resource allocation.

摘要

非法野生动植物贸易 (IWT) 仍是全球生物多样性丧失的主要驱动因素, 并被公认为最有利可图的跨国有组织犯罪形式之一。一项被广泛引用的估值估计IWT年价值为70–230亿美元；然而, 其方法不明确且已过时, 此后世界已发生重大变化。因此, 我们开发了一种方法透明且更新的全球非法野生动植物贸易价值估算方法。基于TRAFFIC开放获取的“野生动植物贸易门户网站”中报告的IWT查获案件, 我们通过系统检索获取每个物种–产品组合的价格, 随后使用扩展因子进行校正, 以计入漏报和漏检情况。基于2016至2021年间报告的查获数据, 我们在对全球报告数量和未检测查获进行校正后, 保守估计IWT的年平均经济价值为340 ± 34.2亿美元 (第5–第95百分位数不确定性区间:284–395亿美元) 。此外, 对TRAFFIC查获记录的分析表明, 非CITES所列分类单元约占报告查获总经济价值的5%, 凸显了国际贸易中未受管制物种的存在及监管空白。我们的透明且可复现的框架为长期存在的低估提供了必要的更新, 可进一步与国际执法和资源配置工作相衔接。
